asset_set: Questionnaire Q18 option 1 — Planning corporate takeover

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under chessboard and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle wood-grain suggestion on board via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: bold confident strategy energy — approachable boardroom game, not hostile takeover
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: coral
accent.use: king piece accent ring, blazer cuff piping

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops and chess piece
color.accent_rule: coral appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on the king piece crown and chart card edge
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under chessboard and hands

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: moves the king chess piece forward
left_hand.grip: pinch grip at the piece crown
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: slides a strategy chart card into place
right_hand.grip: flat fingers sliding the card edge

pose.gesture_summary: mid-move freeze frame — the king piece settling into a new square
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of confident hands moves a tall king chess piece forward while the other slides a strategy chart card into place across a polished table, capturing a decisive boardroom strategy moment. The scene reads as bold competitive strategy, not aggression.

primary_objects.name: chessboard
primary_objects.detail: simple two-tone squares, only a few pieces remaining on the board

primary_objects.name: king chess piece
primary_objects.detail: tall silhouette with a coral accent ring at the base

primary_objects.name: strategy chart card
primary_objects.detail: abstract upward bar shapes, no readable text

subject.environment: polished war-room table strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges, no wall or window

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from chart card → table center → king piece
focal_hierarchy: right hand sliding the chart card
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 40px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: table edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: chessboard silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter E, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, hostile takeover violence, aggressive body language, guns, blood
